Saved the research deliverables:

- [Discovery](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/research/discovery.md>)
- [Clause-by-clause draft](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/research/draft.md>)
- [Source map](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/research/source-map.json>) and [source index](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/research/sources/index.md>)
- [Revealed plan](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M10-A/treatment/research/revealed-plan.md>)

The research compares streaming Rust readers, Arrow batches, DuckDB, OpenRefine and Power Query. It covers sampling, locale-sensitive dates, workbook values, rejects, memory limits and a documented Excel-date regression/fix chain. [DuckDB CSV inference](https://duckdb.org/docs/current/data/csv/auto_detection), [Calamine cell types](https://docs.rs/calamine/0.36.1/calamine/enum.Data.html), [OpenRefine issue #1908](https://github.com/OpenRefine/OpenRefine/issues/1908) and [fix PR #2909](https://github.com/OpenRefine/OpenRefine/pull/2909).

**Process deviation:** a file-write retry rewrote `discovery.md` after the reveal. I left it unchanged afterward and documented the deviation in `draft.md`; treat the pre-reveal freeze state as uncertain. The source-map JSON parsed successfully and the required reveal command ran. No runtime tests or performance checks were executed.

The native Goal completed after the artifacts were saved. Elapsed time was 15 minutes 30 seconds.
